lines.text: GSW notes: 2nd all-time · Stephen Curry, the league's all-time leader in free throw percentage, made his first 51 free throw attempts this season before missing his 12th attempt on Nov. 2 vs. Phoenix. It's the second-longest free throw streak to start a season…
MEM notes — Cameron Boozer: NBA history · Became second youngest player in NBA history to record a triple-double (19 years, 103 days) when he posted 18 PTS, 12 REB and 12 AST on 10/29 at POR.
Cameron Boozer among rookies this season: 4th in points, 1st in rebounds, 2nd in assists, 6th in steals, 5th in threes, 1st in plus/minus
MEM is 11-4: its best start through 15 games since 2014-15 (13-2)
GSW has been outscored by 86 in 1st quarters (−5.7 a game, the worst in the NBA; lost the quarter in 10 of 15 games) and is +92 in the other three quarters combined (overtime not counted)

GSW is 0-4 since 11/11; it went 7-0 in the 7 games before that (10/28 on), after 1-3 to start (8-7 in all). Since then: 30th in net rating (-22.0), 30th in offensive rating (95.2), 30th in FG% (37.6), 26th in assists per turnover (1.5)
GSW has the NBA's 3rd-best record since 2010-11 (769-515); OKC is first at 793-498
Stephen Curry: shooting 50-40-90 (50.0 / 45.7 / 98.7); one miss from the field takes him off it
POR notes: 37th all-time · Holiday is the second current Trail Blazer to crack the NBA’s all-time scoring top 100—Damian Lillard currently ranks 37th on the list (22,879 points).

POR notes: Coming off the bench in every game so far this season, Jrue Holiday ranks highly in several bench categories: Total Bench Points 186 pts (4th); Points Per 36 Minutes 18.1 (4th); Assists Per 36 Minutes 5.5 (2nd); Field Goals Made 60 FGM…
MIL has lost 11 straight: a loss tonight would be its first 12-game losing streak since 1995-96 (March 1996)
MIL is 1-14: its worst start through 15 games in franchise history (since 1968-69)
Donovan Clingan has the 2nd most blocks in the NBA this season. He ranks 122nd in minutes played
MIL has been outscored by 141 in 2nd quarters (−9.4 a game, the worst in the NBA; lost the quarter in 11 of 15 games) and is −56 in the other three quarters combined
Holiday: 1 assist from passing Deron Williams (6,819) for 24th all-time (83% tonight)
MIL is allowing 120.9 points a game (15 games): its most in franchise history
Karl-Anthony Towns: double-double in 14 straight games, every game this season

NYK notes: 3rd in team history · Brunson’s 32nd game recording 30+ points, five or more assists and five or more rebounds ties Walt Frazier for the third-most such games in franchise history (T1- Guerin & Randle: 33) Mikal Bridges recorded 17 points on 63.6-percent…
NYK notes: T-2nd in NBA · The Knicks pulled down 40+ rebounds as a team for the 13th time this season, tying for second in the NBA.
Karl-Anthony Towns: 10+ rebounds in 14 straight games, every game this season

Josh Hart started but wasn't on the floor at the end of NYK's last 5 close games, most recently 11/17 vs TOR (out for the last 5:04); he sat the whole 4th in 2 of them; he had finished 4 of 4 before (close: within 5 in the last five minutes; at the end: on the floor for half of the last three)
Karl-Anthony Towns has the most rebounds in the NBA this season. He ranks 45th in minutes played

Rudy Gobert is 27-for-68 from the field over his last 11 games (39.7%, since 10/26); he had shot 67.2% for his career before that (since 2016-17); also 25-for-60 at the line over his last 12 (64.0% before)
Ayo Dosunmu since Anthony Edwards last played (10/26), 11 games: 21.0 PPG, 4.8 RPG, 3.3 APG, 1.5 SPG, 53% FG, 47% 3PT (12.0 PPG before); MIN's leading scorer, 8-3 in that span
Dylan Harper OUT (left hip soreness): SAS hasn't played without him this season (12-3 with him)
LAC notes: 2nd in NBA · The Clippers currently rank second in the NBA in points off the bench this season (45.8 ppg).
LAC notes — Derrick Jones Jr.: His 114 points through first 10 games (10/21 - 11/13) is the most through his first 10 games of any season (previous: 108 points in 2025-26).
SAS has the NBA's best record since 2004-05 (1100-682)
Victor Wembanyama has 61 blocks this season (15 games): more than 7 whole teams (LAC 59 in 13, ORL 59 in 14, NYK 58 in 14, ATL 58 in 15, …)
SAS is 12-3: its best start through 15 games since 2016-17 (12-3)
De'Aaron Fox has missed his last 13 3-point attempts (over his last 3 games, since 11/11)
Devin Vassell this season (13 games): 11.1 PPG (lowest since his rookie year), 39.8% FG (career-low), 31.6% 3PT (career-low)

situations.text: teams down 10+ in overtime are 1-180 over the last 29 seasons (the one: Minnesota, from 13 down, 3/25/26)
one game of 37,964 since 1996-97 has had the road team score 100 before the home team had 50 (Knicks at Hawks, 4/30/26)
